note.en: At **[R5]**, this weapon can perform as well as [[weapon:starcallers-watch]], but worse than [[weapon:reliquary-of-truth]].
At **[R5]**, this weapon can perform better than [[weapon:starcallers-watch]].
At **[R5]**, this weapon can perform better than [[weapon:dawning-frost]].
At **[R5]**, this weapon can perform better than [[weapon:a-thousand-floating-dreams]].
At **[R5]**, this weapon can perform significantly better in teams with teammates that have 20s Cooldowns on their [[ability:burst]].
This weapon can perform better if the team buff it provides can outweigh the loss in personal damage.
note.fr: Cette arme peut mieux performer si le buff apporté à l'équipe compense la perte de dégâts personnels.
note.it: Quest'arma può dare risultati migliori se il potenziamento che offre al team riesce a compensare la perdita di danni personali.
note.ru: Может показывать себя лучше, если бонус отряду от Пассивной способности перевешивает потерю в личном уроне.
